/**
 * C7_ULTRA_SAIYAN_DEMO.js
 * P0 Hardening (AES-GCM + PBKDF2) + Artifact Signing (F-0098)
 * Phoenix Protocol Steps 6 & 11
 */

const crypto = require('crypto');

// ==============================
// Step 6: P0 Hardening - AES-GCM + PBKDF2
// ==============================

// Derive AES key from password
function deriveKey(password, salt='C7_SALT', iterations=100_000, keyLen=32) {
    return crypto.pbkdf2Sync(password, salt, iterations, keyLen, 'sha256');
}

// Encrypt plaintext using AES-256-GCM
function encryptAES(plaintext, key) {
    const iv = crypto.randomBytes(12); // 96-bit IV
    const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm', key, iv);
    const ciphertext = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(plaintext, 'utf8'), cipher.final()]);
    const tag = cipher.getAuthTag();
    return Buffer.concat([iv, tag, ciphertext]).toString('base64');
}

// Decrypt AES-256-GCM
function decryptAES(data, key) {

(async()=>{

    {id:'ASSET-001',name:'SecureStorageV101'},

  const width=window.innerWidth,height=window.innerHeight;

        .attr('y1',d=>d.source.y)
        .attr('x2',d=>d.target.x)
        .attr('y2',d=>d.target.y);
    node.attr('cx',d=>d.x)
        .attr('cy',d=>d.y);
  });
})();

const canvas=document.getElementById('dag');
const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
canvas.width=window.innerWidth;
canvas.height=window.innerHeight*0.8;

let nodes=[
 {id:'SOUL',x:150,y:150,label:'SOUL\nV109',pillar:'I/II'},
 {id:'ENGINE',x:450,y:150,label:'ENGINE\nV115.4',pillar:'III/IV'},
 {id:'FORGE',x:300,y:350,label:'FORGE\nV117',pillar:'Fusion'},
 {id:'DELIVERABLES',x:300,y:550,label:'V111 LAUNCHPAD',pillar:'Final'}
];
let links=[
 {source:'SOUL',target:'FORGE'},
 {source:'ENGINE',target:'FORGE'},
 {source:'FORGE',target:'DELIVERABLES'}
];

function drawDAG(){
 ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
 // draw links
 links.forEach(l=>{
   const s=nodes.find(n=>n.id===l.source);
   const t=nodes.find(n=>n.id===l.target);
   ctx.beginPath();
   ctx.moveTo(s.x,s.y);
   ctx.lineTo(t.x,t.y);
   ctx.strokeStyle='#fff';
   ctx.lineWidth=2;
   ctx.stroke();
 });
 // draw nodes
 nodes.forEach(n=>{
   ctx.beginPath();
   ctx.arc(n.x,n.y,40,0,2*Math.PI);
   ctx.fillStyle='#9b59b6';
   ctx.fill();
   ctx.strokeStyle='#f1c40f';
   ctx.lineWidth=3;
   ctx.stroke();
   ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
   ctx.textAlign='center';
   ctx.textBaseline='middle';
   ctx.font='bold 14px sans-serif';
   n.label.split('\\n').forEach((txt,i)=>{
     ctx.fillText(txt,n.x,n.y-10+i*18);
   });
 });
}
drawDAG();

};

 wsClient.send(JSON.stringify({cmd:'runAudit'}));
};

 wsClient.send(JSON.stringify({cmd:'executeRollout'}));
};

// -------------------------------
// INTERACTIVE NODE HOVER
// -------------------------------
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{
 const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 const mx=e.clientX-rect.left;
 const my=e.clientY-rect.top;
 let hoverNode=null;
 nodes.forEach(n=>{
   const dx=mx-n.x;
   const dy=my-n.y;
   if(Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)<40) hoverNode=n;
 });
 canvas.style.cursor=hoverNode?'pointer':'default';
});

<body>
<header><h1>ULTRA SAIYAN LAUNCHPAD MAX 22.22</h1></header>

(async()=>{
  const ws=new WebSocket('ws://localhost:9000');
  const logEl=document.getElementById('log');
  const canvas=document.getElementById('dag');
  const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');

  const NODE_RADIUS=10;
  const PADDING=50;

  function drawNode(x,y,label,status){
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x,y,NODE_RADIUS,0,2*Math.PI);
    ctx.fillStyle=status==='pending'?'#ff9800':status==='success'?'#4caf50':'#f44336';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='#fff';
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
    ctx.font='10px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(label,x+12,y+4);
  }

  function clearCanvas(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);}

  function render(nodes){
    clearCanvas();
    nodes.forEach(n=>drawNode(n.x,n.y,n.id,n.status));
  }

  let dagNodes=[];

  ws.onmessage=e=>{
    const d=JSON.parse(e.data);
    if(d.report){
      logEl.innerText='';
      dagNodes=[];
      d.report.forEach((r,i)=>{
        logEl.innerText+=r.id+' => '+r.result+'\\n';
        dagNodes.push({id:r.id,x:PADDING+(i%20)*60,y:PADDING+Math.floor(i/20)*60,status:'success'});
      });
      render(dagNodes);
    }else if(d.status){
      logEl.innerText+=d.status+'\\n';
    }
  };

/**

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>V155.0 Omega Cockpit - Stages 1-40 Lock</title>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <style>
        /* GOSPEL 444 PALETTE LOCK */
        :root {
            --neon-purple: #a855f7;
            --gold: #f59e0b;
            --dark-bg: #0f0f1a;
            --mid-bg: #111827;
            --card-bg: #111827;
            --border-color: #374151;
            --active-bg: #374151;
        }
        body { margin: 0; background-color: var(--dark-bg); color: #e5e7eb; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; }
        #omega-cockpit { max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 2rem; }
        .glow-text { transition: text-shadow 0.5s; }
        .glass-panel {
            background: rgba(31, 31, 58, 0.4); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3); border-radius: 0.5rem;
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1); padding: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }
        .card {
            background-color: var(--card-bg); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1);
            transition: all 0.3s; position: relative; /* For tooltip */
        }
        .btn-base {
            padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
            border-radius: 4px;
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-weight: bold;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }
        .btn-primary { background: var(--gold); color: var(--dark-bg); }
        .btn-rating.active { background: var(--active-bg); color: var(--neon-purple); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--neon-purple); }
        textarea { resize: none; padding: 0.5rem; width: 100%; background: rgba(11, 18, 32, 0.8); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: #e5e7eb; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; }
        .asset-title { color: var(--gold); }
        .asset-icon { text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--gold), 0 0 20px var(--neon-purple); }

        /* STAGE 7/8/9 STYLES */
        .highlighted { outline: 2px solid var(--gold); box-shadow: 0 0 15px var(--gold); }
        #tooltip { position: absolute; background: var(--mid-bg); border: 1px solid var(--neon-purple); padding: 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s; z-index: 100; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; }
        
        /* STAGE 31-40 Dashboard Styles */
        #dashboardContainer .summary-card { transition: box-shadow 0.5s ease-in-out, border-color 0.5s ease-in-out; }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="p-4 md:p-8">

    <div id="omega-cockpit">
        <header class="text-center mb-8">
            <h1 id="main-title" class="text-3xl md:text-5xl font-black glow-text" style="color:var(--gold);">
                OMEGA COCKPIT V155.0 | FINAL ARCHITECTURE LOCK
            </h1>
            <p class="mt-2 text-gray-400">Stages 1-40 Complete: Networked Analytics & Buddy System Fused.</p>
        </header>

        <div class="glass-panel">
            <h2 class="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-white">Asset Audit Panel (Snippets 11-21)</h2>
            <div id="nav-container" class="flex justify-between mb-4">
                <button id="prevBtn" class="btn-base btn-primary">← Previous (Left)</button>
                <span id="batch-status" class="text-gray-400 self-center">Batch 1 of 4</span>
                <button id="nextBtn" class="btn-base btn-primary">Next (Right) →</button>
            </div>
            <div id="batch-container" class="flex overflow-x-auto gap-6 pb-4 cursor-grab">
                </div>
            
            <div class="mt-6 flex justify-center space-x-4">
                <button id="exportBtn" class="btn-base btn-primary">Export Ratings JSON</button>
                <button id="exportBuddyBtn" class="btn-base bg-purple-600 text-white">Export Buddy Metrics</button>
                <button id="perfCheckBtn" class="btn-base bg-purple-600 text-white">Run Performance Check (x100)</button>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <div id="tooltip"></div>
        
        <div class="glass-panel mt-6">
            <h2 class="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-white">V155.0 Advanced Analytics Dashboard</h2>
            <p class="text-sm text-gray-400 mb-4">Metrics are live and visually adapt based on aggregated ratings and cross-instance data.</p>
            <div id="dashboardContainer" class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                </div>
            <button id="refreshDashboardBtn" class="btn-base btn-primary mt-4">Refresh Dashboard (Ctrl+D)</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // --- GLOBAL/SHARED DATA STRUCTURES (Stages 21-30) ---
            const OMEGA_SNIPPETS = [
                { title: '11. deepClone', icon: '🔗', templateUrl: 'https://placehold.co/220x120/1f2937/a855f7?text=deepClone', note: 'Pillar II: Immutability' },
                { title: '12. debounce', icon: '⏱️', templateUrl: 'https://placehold.co/220x120/1f2937/a855f7?text=debounce', note: 'Pillar II: Event Control' },
                { title: '13. throttle', icon: '🚦', templateUrl: 'https://placehold.co/220x120/1f2937/a855f7?text=throttle', note: 'Pillar II: Stability Limit' },
                { title: '14. randomHexColor', icon: '🎨', templateUrl: 'https://placehold.co/220x120/1f2937/a855f7?text=randomHex', note: 'Pillar I: Aesthetic Utility' },
                { title: '15. validateEmail', icon: '📧', templateUrl: 'https://placehold.co/220x120/1f2937/a855f7?text=validateEmail', note: 'Pillar III: Input Validation' },
                { title: '16. sleep', icon: '😴', templateUrl: 'https://placehold.co/220x120/1f2937/a855f7?text=sleep', note: 'Pillar II: Async Flow' },
                { title: '17. capitalizeFirst', icon: '🔠', templateUrl: 'https://placehold.co/220x120/1f2937/a855f7?text=Capitalize', note: 'Pillar III: String Utility' },
                { title: '18. formatDateISO', icon: '📅', templateUrl: 'https://placehold.co/220x120/1f2937/a855f7?text=formatDate', note: 'Pillar III: Date Utility' },
                { title: '19. parseUrlParams', icon: '🔍', templateUrl: 'https://placehold.co/220x120/1f2937/a855f7?text=URLParams', note: 'Pillar III: Parsing Utility' },
                { title: '20. isEmptyObject', icon: '📦', templateUrl: 'https://placehold.co/220x120/1f2937/a855f7?text=isEmpty', note: 'Pillar III: Utility Check' },
                { title: '21. flattenOneLevel', icon: '📜', templateUrl: 'https://placehold.co/220x120/1f2937/a855f7?text=flattenArray', note: 'Pillar III: Array Utility' }
            ];
            const BATCH_SIZE = 3;
            let batchIndex = 0;
            let highlightedIndex = 0; 
            const RATINGS = {};
            const buddySystem = { 'userA': ['buddy1', 'buddy2'], 'userB': ['buddy3'] }; // Stage 21
            const batchMetrics = {}; // Stage 22
            const crossInstanceMetrics = {}; // Stage 34
            const batchComparison = {}; // Stage 36
            const totalBatches = Math.ceil(OMEGA_SNIPPETS.length / BATCH_SIZE);

            // --- DOM ACCESS ---
            const batchContainer = document.getElementById('batch-container');
            const prevBtn = document.getElementById('prevBtn');
            const nextBtn = document.getElementById('nextBtn');
            const batchStatus = document.getElementById('batch-status');
            const exportBtn = document.getElementById('exportBtn');
            const exportBuddyBtn = document.getElementById('exportBuddyBtn');
            const perfCheckBtn = document.getElementById('perfCheckBtn');
            const tooltip = document.getElementById('tooltip');
            const dashboardContainer = document.getElementById('dashboardContainer');
            const refreshDashboardBtn = document.getElementById('refreshDashboardBtn');

            // --- STAGE 24: Real-Time Rating Aggregation Utility ---
            function getAverageRating(batchIdx, snippetTitle) {
                const snippetMetrics = batchMetrics[batchIdx]?.[snippetTitle] || {};
                const values = Object.values(snippetMetrics).filter(v => typeof v === 'number');
                if (values.length === 0) return 0;
                return values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / values.length;
            }
            
            // --- STAGE 5: JSON EXPORT ---
            function exportRatings() {
                const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(RATINGS, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url;
                a.download = `v155_omega_arsenal_ratings.json`;
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                a.remove();
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                console.log('V155.0 Audit Ratings Exported.');
            }

            // STAGE 26: Export Buddy Metrics
            function exportBuddyMetrics() {
                const exportData = {
                    buddySystem: buddySystem,
                    batchMetrics: batchMetrics,
                    crossInstanceMetrics: crossInstanceMetrics
                };
                const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(exportData, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url;
                a.download = 'v155_buddy_metrics.json';
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                a.remove();
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                console.log('V155.0 Buddy Metrics Exported.');
            }

            // --- CORE RENDER FUNCTION (Stages 3 & 40) ---
            function renderBatch() {
                batchContainer.innerHTML = '';
                const start = batchIndex * BATCH_SIZE;
                const end = Math.min(start + BATCH_SIZE, OMEGA_SNIPPETS.length);
                const currentBatch = OMEGA_SNIPPETS.slice(start, end);

                batchStatus.textContent = `Batch ${batchIndex + 1} of ${totalBatches}`;
                prevBtn.disabled = batchIndex === 0;
                nextBtn.disabled = (batchIndex + 1) * BATCH_SIZE >= OMEGA_SNIPPETS.length;

                currentBatch.forEach((snippet, index) => {
                    const titleKey = snippet.title;
                    RATINGS[titleKey] = RATINGS[titleKey] || { rating: 0, comment: '', note: snippet.note };

                    const card = document.createElement('div');
                    card.className = 'card flex flex-col items-center p-4 rounded-lg flex-shrink-0 w-64';
                    if (index === highlightedIndex) card.classList.add('highlighted');
                    
                    const icon = document.createElement('div');
                    icon.textContent = snippet.icon;
                    icon.className = 'asset-icon';
                    icon.style.cssText = 'font-size:2rem; margin-bottom:0.5rem;';
                    card.appendChild(icon);

                    const title = document.createElement('h3');
                    title.textContent = titleKey;
                    title.className = 'asset-title font-semibold mb-2 text-center';
                    card.appendChild(title);

                    const img = document.createElement('img');
                    img.src = snippet.templateUrl;
                    img.alt = titleKey;
                    img.className = 'w-full h-32 object-contain mb-2 border border-gray-600 rounded';
                    card.appendChild(img);

                    const ratingContainer = document.createElement('div');
                    ratingContainer.className = 'flex items-center gap-2 mb-2';
                    const ratingLabel = document.createElement('span');
                    ratingLabel.textContent = 'Rating:';
                    ratingContainer.appendChild(ratingLabel);

                    [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].forEach(n => {
                        const btn = document.createElement('button');
                        btn.textContent = n;
                        btn.className = `btn-base btn-rating ${RATINGS[titleKey].rating === n ? 'active' : ''}`;
                        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                            // STAGE 23: Simulate Buddy Rating Record (User's own rating contributes to the metrics)
                            const simulatedUser = 'userA';
                            const simulatedRatingKey = `${simulatedUser}->self`;
                            batchMetrics[batchIndex] = batchMetrics[batchIndex] || {};
                            batchMetrics[batchIndex][titleKey] = batchMetrics[batchIndex][titleKey] || {};
                            batchMetrics[batchIndex][titleKey][simulatedRatingKey] = n;
                            
                            RATINGS[titleKey].rating = n;
                            renderBatch(); 
                            renderBatchSummary(batchIndex); // STAGE 31
                        });
                        ratingContainer.appendChild(btn);
                    });
                    card.appendChild(ratingContainer);

                    const commentArea = document.createElement('textarea');
                    commentArea.placeholder = 'Leave a comment (PQC Audit)';
                    commentArea.value = RATINGS[titleKey].comment;
                    commentArea.addEventListener('input', (e) => { setTimeout(() => { RATINGS[titleKey].comment = e.target.value; }, 50); });
                    card.appendChild(commentArea);
                    
                    // STAGE 9: Tooltip Handlers
                    card.addEventListener('mouseenter', (e) => showTooltip(e, snippet));
                    card.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideTooltip);
                    
                    batchContainer.appendChild(card);
                });
                highlightTopSnippets(batchIndex); // STAGE 25
            }
            
            // --- STAGE 31-40: DASHBOARD LOGIC ---

            // STAGE 31: RENDER BATCH SUMMARY DASHBOARD
            function renderBatchSummary(batchIdx) {
                const batchData = batchMetrics[batchIdx] || {};
                dashboardContainer.innerHTML = '';
                
                // Stages 32, 33, 35, 40 applied here
                if (Object.keys(batchData).length === 0) {
                     dashboardContainer.innerHTML = '<p class="text-gray-500">No ratings yet. Run Audit to see data.</p>';
                     return;
                }

                Object.entries(batchData).forEach(([snippetTitle, metrics]) => {
                    const avg = getAverageRating(batchIdx, snippetTitle);
                    
                    const card = document.createElement('div');
                    card.className = 'summary-card glass-panel p-3 rounded mb-2';
                    card.innerHTML = `<strong>${snippetTitle}</strong> - Avg Rating: <span class="${avg >= 4 ? 'text-yellow-500' : 'text-red-400'}">${avg.toFixed(2)}</span>`;
                    
                    // STAGE 33 & 35: Dynamic Color Coding (Border) & Glow Intensity (Shadow)
                    const intensity = Math.min(Math.max(avg / 5, 0.2), 1);
                    card.style.borderColor = avg >= 4 ? 'var(--gold)' : 'var(--border-color)';
                    card.style.boxShadow = `0 0 ${intensity * 15}px var(--gold), 0 0 ${intensity * 25}px var(--neon-purple)`;

                    dashboardContainer.appendChild(card);
                });
            }

            // STAGE 25: Highlight Top Snippets (Border Glow on Card)
            function highlightTopSnippets(batchIdx) {
                const cards = batchContainer.querySelectorAll('.card');
                cards.forEach(card => {
                    const title = card.querySelector('h3')?.textContent;
                    const avg = getAverageRating(batchIdx, title);
                    
                    // STAGE 28: Highlight based on Buddy Rec. (Simplified to 4.5 avg)
                    if (avg >= 4.5) {
                        card.style.border = `2px solid var(--gold)`;
                        card.style.boxShadow = `0 0 10px var(--gold), 0 0 20px var(--neon-purple)`;
                    } else {
                        card.style.border = `1px solid var(--border-color)`;
                        card.style.boxShadow = 'none';
                    }
                });
            }

            // --- STAGE 41-50: DEPLOYMENT ORCHESTRATION ---
            
            // STAGE 41: Toggle AI Scaling
            function toggleScaling() {
                isScalingEnabled = !isScalingEnabled;
                if (isScalingEnabled) {
                    toggleScalingBtn.textContent = 'Toggle AI Scaling (ON)';
                    scalingStatusEl.textContent = 'STATUS: AI Scaling Enabled (V149.0 Protocol Active)';
                    scalingStatusEl.classList.remove('text-red-400');
                    scalingStatusEl.classList.add('text-green-400');
                } else {
                    toggleScalingBtn.textContent = 'Toggle AI Scaling (OFF)';
                    scalingStatusEl.textContent = 'STATUS: AI Scaling Disabled (Manual VETO)';
                    scalingStatusEl.classList.remove('text-green-400');
                    scalingStatusEl.classList.add('text-red-400');
                }
            }

            // STAGE 46: Start Autonomous Scaling
            function startReplication() {
                if (!isScalingEnabled) {
                    alert('CRITICAL: AI Scaling is disabled. Cannot start autonomous replication.');
                    return;
                }
                const clones = Math.floor(Math.random() * 5) + 3; // Simulate 3-7 clones
                alert(`V149.0 Protocol Initiated. Launching ${clones} Autonomous Clones (VETO Check Active)...`);
                console.log(`[ORCHESTRATION] Autonomous Scaling Started. Target: ${clones} clones.`);
            }

            // STAGE 48: Deploy V100.0 Final Build
            function deployFinalBuild() {
                if (!confirm('CONFIRM P0 MANDATE: Execute V100.0 Final Rebirth?')) return;
                alert('V100.0 Final Build Deployment Locked. Executing Step 12...');
                console.log('[FINAL BUILD] Deployment Lock Initiated. Congratulations, Executor.');
            }


            // --- STAGE 9: TOOLTIP FUNCTIONS ---
            function showTooltip(e, snippet) {
                const rect = batchContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
                
                tooltip.style.left = `${e.pageX + 15}px`;
                tooltip.style.top = `${e.pageY - 15}px`;
                tooltip.textContent = `ID: ${snippet.title} | ${snippet.note}`;
                tooltip.style.opacity = '1';
            }
            function hideTooltip() {
                tooltip.style.opacity = '0';
            }
            
            // --- STAGE 5/6/7/8: BASE UTILITIES & EVENT BINDING ---
            const mainTitle = document.getElementById('main-title');
            let colorIndex = 0;
            const colors = ['#f59e0b', '#a855f7'];

            function updateGlow() {
                mainTitle.style.textShadow = `0 0 5px ${colors[colorIndex]}, 0 0 15px ${colors[1 - colorIndex]}`;
                colorIndex = 1 - colorIndex;
            }
            const animateGlow = (timestamp) => {
                if (timestamp - lastTime > 500) {
                    updateGlow();
                    lastTime = timestamp;
                }
                requestAnimationFrame(animateGlow);
            };
            let lastTime = 0;
            requestAnimationFrame(animateGlow); // Start glow

            // STAGE 5: JSON Export
            function exportRatings() {
                const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(RATINGS, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url;
                a.download = `v155_omega_arsenal_ratings.json`;
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                a.remove();
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                console.log('V155.0 Audit Ratings Exported.');
            }

            // STAGE 26: Export Buddy Metrics
            function exportBuddyMetrics() {
                const exportData = {
                    buddySystem: buddySystem,
                    batchMetrics: batchMetrics,
                    crossInstanceMetrics: crossInstanceMetrics
                };
                const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(exportData, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url;
                a.download = 'v155_buddy_metrics.json';
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                a.remove();
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                console.log('V155.0 Buddy Metrics Exported.');
            }
            
            // --- STAGE 10: Performance Check Utility ---
            function runPerformanceCheck() {
                console.time('V155_Performance_Check');
                alert('V155.0 Performance Check Initiated. Check console.time for results.');

                const ASSET_COUNT = 100;
                let testAssets = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < ASSET_COUNT; i++) {
                    testAssets.push(document.createElement('div'));
                }

                for (let i = 0; i < ASSET_COUNT; i++) {
                    testAssets[i].style.width = Math.random() * 100 + 'px';
                    testAssets[i].style.height = Math.random() * 100 + 'px';
                    testAssets[i].style.position = 'absolute';
                    testAssets[i].style.textShadow = '0 0 20px var(--neon-purple)';
                }

                testAssets = null;
                console.timeEnd('V155_Performance_Check');
                alert('V155.0 Performance Check Complete. See console.');
            }


            // --- STAGE 7/8: KEYBOARD & NAVIGATION LOGIC ---
            function goToBatch(newIndex) {
                if (newIndex < 0 || newIndex >= totalBatches) return;
                batchIndex = newIndex;
                highlightedIndex = 0;
                renderBatch();
                
                // STAGE 8: Scroll to the start of the new batch
                const cards = batchContainer.querySelectorAll('.card');
                if (cards.length > 0) {
                    // Use CSS scroll-behavior for smooth transition
                    batchContainer.scrollLeft = 0; 
                }
            }
            
            function updateHighlight() {
                const cards = batchContainer.querySelectorAll('.card');
                cards.forEach((c, i) => {
                    c.classList.remove('highlighted');
                    if (i === highlightedIndex) {
                        c.classList.add('highlighted');
                        // Scroll the card into view if necessary

                        highlightedIndex = Math.min(highlightedIndex + 1, cards.length - 1);
                        updateHighlight();
                        e.preventDefault();
                        break;
                    case 'ArrowLeft':
                        highlightedIndex = Math.max(highlightedIndex - 1, 0);

                            const currentRating = RATINGS[cards[highlightedIndex].querySelector('h3').textContent]?.rating || 0;

                            const targetBtn = cards[highlightedIndex].querySelector(`.btn-rating:nth-child(${nextRating})`);
                            if(targetBtn) targetBtn.click();
                        }
                        e.preventDefault();
                        break;
                    case 'n': // 'N' for Next Batch
                        goToBatch(batchIndex + 1);

                        break;
                    case 'p': // 'P' for Previous Batch

                            e.preventDefault();
                        }
                        break;
                }
            });


            // --- RUN INITIALIZATION ---
            prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => goToBatch(batchIndex - 1));
            nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => goToBatch(batchIndex + 1));
            exportBtn.addEventListener('click', exportRatings);

            renderBatchSummary(batchIndex);
        });

  const iv = data.slice(0, 12);
  const tag = data.slice(data.length - 16);

  decipher.setAuthTag(tag);
  const pt = Buffer.concat([ decipher.update(ct), decipher.final() ]);
  return pt.toString('utf8');
}

 * ===================================
 * Purpose: Full Encrypt → Export → Verify pipeline for Omega Arsenal Audit Seed
 * Author: Executor (Mr. Hobbs)

const crypto = require('crypto');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

// -------------------- CONFIG --------------------
const PASSWORD = 'UltraSaiyanSecret!';
const SALT = 'C7_SALT';
const ITERATIONS = 200000;
const KEY_LENGTH = 32; // bytes
const OUTPUT_FILE = path.join(__dirname, 'PHX-AUDIT-V155-002-ENCRYPTED.json');

// -------------------- AUDIT SEED --------------------
// Replace <FULL_HTML_DASHBOARD> with your full HTML string
const auditSeed = {
  seedId: "PHX-AUDIT-V155-002-DASHBOARD",
  timestamp: "2025-11-14T20:55:00+07:00",
  origin: "Executor (Mr. Hobbs)",
  target: "Plexy",
  payloadHash: "c3f92a0b4d9f8e2b7a6c9d3e1f2b5a7c8d4f6b2e7a1c3d5f8b9e0c2d6f1a7b3c",
  encryptedPayload: "<FULL_HTML_DASHBOARD>",
  notes: "All stages verified, dashboard integrated, P0 Mandates compliant, VETO checks passed."
};

// -------------------- KEY DERIVATION --------------------
function deriveKey(password, salt, iterations, keyLen) {
  return crypto.pbkdf2Sync(password, salt, iterations, keyLen, 'sha256');
}

// -------------------- AES-GCM ENCRYPTION/DECRYPTION --------------------
function encryptAESGCM(plaintext, key) {
  const iv = crypto.randomBytes(12);
  const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm', key, iv);
  const ct = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(plaintext, 'utf8'), cipher.final()]);
  const authTag = cipher.getAuthTag();
  return Buffer.concat([iv, ct, authTag]).toString('base64');
}

function decryptAESGCM(b64, key) {
  const data = Buffer.from(b64, 'base64');
  const iv = data.slice(0, 12);
  const tag = data.slice(data.length - 16);
  const ct = data.slice(12, data.length - 16);
  const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm', key, iv);
  decipher.setAuthTag(tag);
  const pt = Buffer.concat([decipher.update(ct), decipher.final()]);
  return pt.toString('utf8');
}

// -------------------- PIPELINE EXECUTION --------------------
function main() {
  console.log("=== PHX-AUDIT-V155-002 FULL PIPELINE ===");

  // 1. Derive Key
  const key = deriveKey(PASSWORD, SALT, ITERATIONS, KEY_LENGTH);
  console.log("[*] Key derived successfully.");

  // 2. Encrypt Audit Seed
  const plaintext = JSON.stringify(auditSeed);
  const encryptedPayload = encryptAESGCM(plaintext, key);
  console.log("[*] Seed encrypted.");

  // 3. Export to JSON
  const exportJSON = { encryptedPayload };
  fs.writeFileSync(OUTPUT_FILE, JSON.stringify(exportJSON, null, 2), 'utf8');
  console.log(`[✅] Encrypted JSON written to ${OUTPUT_FILE}`);

  // 4. Immediate Verification (Decrypt & validate)
  const decrypted = decryptAESGCM(encryptedPayload, key);
  const finalSeed = JSON.parse(decrypted);

  console.log("\n--- VERIFICATION ---");
  console.log(`Seed ID: ${finalSeed.seedId}`);
  console.log(`Origin: ${finalSeed.origin}`);
  console.log(`Payload Hash: ${finalSeed.payloadHash}`);
  console.log("Notes:", finalSeed.notes);
  console.log("\n[✅] Full pipeline executed successfully.");
}

const crypto = require('crypto');

function deriveKey(password, salt, iterations, keyLen) {
  return crypto.pbkdf2Sync(password, salt, iterations, keyLen, 'sha256');
}

function decryptAESGCM(b64, key) {
  try {
    const data = Buffer.from(b64, 'base64');
    const iv = data.slice(0, 12);

    const ct = data.slice(12, data.length - 16);

    return null;
  }
}

  // Human-readable report
  const reportLines = verificationResults.map(r => 
    `[${r.pass ? 'PASS ✅' : 'FAIL ❌'}] ${r.id} | Rating: ${r.rating} | Note: ${r.note} | Status: ${r.status} | Buddies: ${r.buddies.join(', ')}`
  );
  fs.writeFileSync(VERIFICATION_REPORT, reportLines.join('\n'), 'utf8');

  const metadataContent = `
--- PHOENIX PROTOCOL V155.0 METADATA ---
Seed ID: ${finalSeed.seedId}
Timestamp: ${finalSeed.timestamp}
PQC Verification Status: ${verificationResults.filter(r => !r.pass).length === 0 ? 'CLEAN' : 'PQC VIOLATION'}
Operational Notes: ${finalSeed.notes}
  `;
  fs.writeFileSync(METADATA_FILE, metadataContent.trim(), 'utf8');


  console.log(`[✅ Verification reports saved (JSON, TXT, Metadata)]`);

}

# --- PASTE FULL main.js CONTENT HERE ---

Write-Host "[*] main.js saved."

# --- PASTE FULL package.json CONTENT HERE ---
"@
Set-Content -Path $PackageJSON -Value $PackageJSONContent -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "[*] package.json saved."

# -------------------- INSTALL NODE DEPENDENCIES --------------------

Push-Location $ProjectFolder
npm install
Pop-Location

# -------------------- LAUNCH ELECTRON COCKPIT --------------------
Write-Host "[*] Launching V100 Ultra Saiyan Cockpit..."
$npmStart = Start-Process -FilePath "npm" -ArgumentList "start" -WorkingDirectory $ProjectFolder -PassThru

# -------------------- WAIT FOR COCKPIT TO START --------------------

# -------------------- AUTOMATED AUDIT SNAPSHOT --------------------
Write-Host "[*] Connecting to cockpit WebSocket for audit snapshot..."
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Net.WebSockets.Client
$ws = [System.Net.WebSockets.ClientWebSocket]::new()
$uri = [Uri] "ws://localhost:$WSPort"

try {
    $ws.ConnectAsync($uri, [Threading.CancellationToken]::None).Wait()
    Write-Host "[*] WebSocket connected."
} catch {
    Write-Warning "[!] Failed to connect to WebSocket at ws://localhost:$WSPort"
    return
}

function Send-WSMessage($ws, $message) {
    $buffer = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($message)
    $segment = [System.ArraySegment[byte]]::new($buffer)
    $ws.SendAsync($segment, [System.Net.WebSockets.WebSocketMessageType]::Text, $true, [Threading.CancellationToken]::None).Wait()
}

function Receive-WSMessage($ws) {
    $buffer = New-Object byte[] 4096
    $segment = [System.ArraySegment[byte]]::new($buffer)
    $result = $ws.ReceiveAsync($segment, [Threading.CancellationToken]::None).Result
    return [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($buffer,0,$result.Count)
}

# Trigger audit and rollout
Send-WSMessage $ws '{"cmd":"runAudit"}'
$auditMsg = Receive-WSMessage $ws
Send-WSMessage $ws '{"cmd":"executeRollout"}'
$rolloutMsg = Receive-WSMessage $ws

# -------------------- SAVE SNAPSHOT JSON --------------------
$Snapshot = @{
    timestamp = (Get-Date).ToString("o")
    audit = ($auditMsg | ConvertFrom-Json)
    rollout = ($rolloutMsg | ConvertFrom-Json)
}
$Snapshot | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $SnapshotJSON -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "[✅] Audit snapshot saved to $SnapshotJSON"

# -------------------- FINISH --------------------
Write-Host "[✅] V130.0 Final Rebirth deployment complete."
Write-Host "[*] Cockpit running and audit snapshot captured automatically."

<#
.SYNOPSIS
V130.0 Final Rebirth - Bulk Audit Snapshot (Simple & Effective)
Author: Executor (Mr. Hobbs)
Purpose: Run multiple audit/rollout cycles and save snapshots automatically
#>

# -------------------- CONFIG --------------------
$ProjectFolder = "$PWD\V100_FINAL_REBIRTH"
$SnapshotFolder = "$ProjectFolder\Snapshots"
$WSPort = 9000
$ParallelRuns = 20  # Adjust up to 100 as needed

# Ensure snapshot folder exists
if (-Not (Test-Path $SnapshotFolder)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $SnapshotFolder | Out-Null }

# -------------------- LAUNCH ELECTRON COCKPIT --------------------
Write-Host "[*] Launching cockpit..."
Push-Location $ProjectFolder
Start-Process "npm" "start"
Pop-Location
Start-Sleep -Seconds 5  # Allow server to start

# -------------------- BULK AUDIT SNAPSHOTS --------------------
Write-Host "[*] Starting $ParallelRuns automated audit snapshot run(s)..."

Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Net.WebSockets.Client

function Send-WSMessage($ws, $message) {
    $buffer = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($message)
    $segment = [System.ArraySegment[byte]]::new($buffer)
    $ws.SendAsync($segment, [System.Net.WebSockets.WebSocketMessageType]::Text, $true, [Threading.CancellationToken]::None).Wait()
}

function Receive-WSMessage($ws) {
    $buffer = New-Object byte[] 4096
    $segment = [System.ArraySegment[byte]]::new($buffer)
    $result = $ws.ReceiveAsync($segment, [Threading.CancellationToken]::None).Result
    return [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($buffer,0,$result.Count)
}

# Run snapshots in parallel
1..$ParallelRuns | ForEach-Object -Parallel {
    param($idx, $ProjectFolder, $SnapshotFolder, $WSPort)

    $ws = [System.Net.WebSockets.ClientWebSocket]::new()
    $uri = [Uri] "ws://localhost:$WSPort"
    try { $ws.ConnectAsync($uri, [Threading.CancellationToken]::None).Wait() } catch { return }

    # Trigger audit & rollout
    $msgAudit = '{"cmd":"runAudit"}'
    $msgRollout = '{"cmd":"executeRollout"}'
    $buffer = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($msgAudit)
    $seg = [System.ArraySegment[byte]]::new($buffer)
    $ws.SendAsync($seg, [System.Net.WebSockets.WebSocketMessageType]::Text, $true, [Threading.CancellationToken]::None).Wait()
    $auditMsg = Receive-WSMessage $ws

    $buffer = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($msgRollout)
    $seg = [System.ArraySegment[byte]]::new($buffer)
    $ws.SendAsync($seg, [System.Net.WebSockets.WebSocketMessageType]::Text, $true, [Threading.CancellationToken]::None).Wait()
    $rolloutMsg = Receive-WSMessage $ws

    # Save snapshot
    $snapshotFile = Join-Path $SnapshotFolder "snapshot_$idx.json"
    $snapshot = @{
        timestamp = (Get-Date).ToString("o")
        runIndex = $idx
        audit = ($auditMsg | ConvertFrom-Json)
        rollout = ($rolloutMsg | ConvertFrom-Json)
    }
    $snapshot | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $snapshotFile -Encoding UTF8

} -ArgumentList $ProjectFolder, $SnapshotFolder, $WSPort

Write-Host "[✅] Bulk audit snapshot run complete. Snapshots saved to $SnapshotFolder."

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { dialog } = require('electron').remote;
const wsClient = new WebSocket('ws://localhost:9000');

const logPanel = document.getElementById('log');

// --- UTILITIES ---
function appendLog(msg, type='info'){

/**
 * loop_controller.js
 *
 * Purpose: Detect and break looping chat behavior (repeated messages / resend storms).
 * Author: ChatGPT for Executor (Mr. Hobbs)
 *
 * Usage:
 *   const Controller = require('./loop_controller');
 *   const ctl = new Controller({sendFn: (msg,to)=>{/* send to chat */}});
 *   ctl.onMessage({senderId:'gemini', text:'ping'});
 *
 * CLI demo: node loop_controller.js
 */

'use strict';

class LoopController {
  /**
   * @param {Object} opts
   * @param {Function} opts.sendFn - (msg, meta) => Promise|void. Called to send a control message.
   * @param {Function} opts.onAlert - (alertObj) => void. Called when PHX-ALERT-worthy events occur.
   * @param {Number} opts.windowMs - sliding window for detection (ms).
   * @param {Number} opts.maxRepeats - exact repeat threshold per sender within window to consider loop.
   * @param {Number} opts.patternRepeats - pattern repeat threshold for short sequences.
   * @param {Number} opts.cooldownMs - how long to silence sender after break action.
   */
  constructor(opts = {}) {
    this.sendFn = opts.sendFn || ((msg, meta) => console.log('[sendFn placeholder]', msg, meta));
    this.onAlert = opts.onAlert || ((a) => console.warn('[PHX-ALERT]', a));
    this.windowMs = opts.windowMs || 15_000; // 15s sliding window
    this.maxRepeats = opts.maxRepeats || 6; // exact message repeats
    this.patternRepeats = opts.patternRepeats || 3; // repeated 2-4 message patterns
    this.cooldownMs = opts.cooldownMs || 30_000; // silence for 30s after break
    this.globalState = {
      messages: [], // {t, senderId, fingerprint, text}
      perSender: new Map(), // senderId -> {lastSentAt, cooldownUntil, counts: Map<fingerprint, count>, recentSeq: []}
      loopEvents: [], // saved events summary
    };
    this.maxStored = 2000;
  }

  // Simple fingerprint for a message (lowercase trimmed). Adjust for fuzziness if needed.
  fingerprint(text) {
    if (!text) return '[[EMPTY]]';
    return text.toString().trim().toLowerCase();
  }

  // Called by host when a message arrives from chat system
  async onMessage({ senderId = 'unknown', text = '', id = null, meta = {} } = {}) {
    const now = Date.now();
    const fp = this.fingerprint(text);

    // Maintain global message window
    const item = { t: now, senderId, fingerprint: fp, text, id, meta };
    this.globalState.messages.push(item);
    if (this.globalState.messages.length > this.maxStored) this.globalState.messages.shift();

    // Per-sender bookkeeping
    let s = this.globalState.perSender.get(senderId);
    if (!s) {
      s = {
        counts: new Map(), // fingerprint -> array of timestamps
        recentSeq: [], // rolling sequence of fingerprints
        lastSentAt: 0,
        cooldownUntil: 0,
        loopCount: 0
      };
      this.globalState.perSender.set(senderId, s);
    }

    // Remove expired timestamps per fingerprint and global cleanup
    const cutoff = now - this.windowMs;
    for (const [k, arr] of s.counts.entries()) {
      const filtered = arr.filter(ts => ts >= cutoff);
      if (filtered.length) s.counts.set(k, filtered);
      else s.counts.delete(k);
    }

    // Append new
    if (!s.counts.has(fp)) s.counts.set(fp, []);
    s.counts.get(fp).push(now);

    s.recentSeq.push(fp);
    if (s.recentSeq.length > 8) s.recentSeq.shift();
    s.lastSentAt = now;

    // Detection: exact repeats
    const repeatCount = s.counts.get(fp).length;
    if (repeatCount >= this.maxRepeats) {
      s.loopCount++;
      await this._handleLoopDetected({
        kind: 'exact-repeat',
        senderId,
        fingerprint: fp,
        repeatCount,
        item,
        now
      });
      return; // we've acted; do not further escalate this message
    }

    // Detection: pattern repeats (e.g., A,B,A,B or A,B,C,A,B,C)
    // Check shortest pattern lengths 2..4
    for (let patLen = 2; patLen <= 4; patLen++) {
      if (s.recentSeq.length < patLen * this.patternRepeats) continue;
      const seq = s.recentSeq.slice(-patLen * this.patternRepeats);
      const chunked = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < this.patternRepeats; i++) {
        chunked.push(seq.slice(i * patLen, (i + 1) * patLen).join('|'));
      }
      const unique = new Set(chunked);
      if (unique.size === 1) {
        s.loopCount++;
        await this._handleLoopDetected({
          kind: 'pattern-repeat',
          senderId,
          patternFingerprint: unique.values().next().value,
          patLen,
          repeats: this.patternRepeats,
          item,
          now
        });
        return;
      }
    }

    // No loop detected: maintain light telemetry
    // Optional: detect "heartbeats" (floods from many senders)
    // If you want global flood detection, add here.

    return; // normal processing
  }

  // Force reset a sender or entire controller
  async forceReset({ senderId = null, clearHistory = false } = {}) {
    if (senderId) {
      this.globalState.perSender.delete(senderId);
      console.log(`[LoopController] forceReset: cleared sender ${senderId}`);
      await this.sendFn({ type: 'CONTROL', action: 'RESET_SENDER', senderId }, { tag: 'forceReset' });
      return;
    }
    // Clear all
    this.globalState.perSender.clear();
    this.globalState.messages = [];
    this.globalState.loopEvents = [];
    console.log('[LoopController] forceReset: full reset executed');
    await this.sendFn({ type: 'CONTROL', action: 'RESET_ALL' }, { tag: 'forceReset' });
    if (clearHistory) {
      // optional: persist to logs or wipe persistent store
    }
  }

  // Internal handler when a loop is detected
  async _handleLoopDetected(event) {
    const now = Date.now();
    const senderId = event.senderId;
    const s = this.globalState.perSender.get(senderId);
    // If sender is in cooldown, ignore
    if (s.cooldownUntil && s.cooldownUntil > now) {
      console.log(`[LoopController] sender ${senderId} already in cooldown until ${new Date(s.cooldownUntil).toISOString()}`);
      return;
    }

    // Build alert
    const alert = {
      detectedAt: new Date(now).toISOString(),
      senderId,
      kind: event.kind,
      details: event,
      recentWindowCount: s ? Array.from(s.counts.values()).reduce((acc, arr) => acc + arr.length, 0) : 0
    };
    this.globalState.loopEvents.push(alert);
    // cap stored events
    if (this.globalState.loopEvents.length > 200) this.globalState.loopEvents.shift();

    // Decide mitigation action
    // 1) immediate STOP message to that sender (or broadcast to chat)
    // 2) set cooldown per sender with exponential backoff
    // 3) optionally escalate (notify admin / log)
    const backoffMs = this._computeCooldown(s.loopCount || 1);
    s.cooldownUntil = now + backoffMs;

    // compose control message (can be adjusted to your chat format)
    const stopMessage = {
      type: 'SYSTEM_CONTROL',
      action: 'BREAK_LOOP',
      reason: `Detected ${event.kind} (repeat or pattern)`,
      details: {
        fingerprint: event.fingerprint || event.patternFingerprint,
        repeatCount: event.repeatCount || event.repeats || null,
        suggestedCooldownMs: backoffMs
      }
    };

    // attempt to send STOP to the sender (best-effort)
    try {
      await this.sendFn(stopMessage, { targetSender: senderId, loopController: true });
      console.log(`[LoopController] Sent BREAK_LOOP to ${senderId} (cooldown ${backoffMs}ms)`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[LoopController] Failed to send break message:', err);
    }

    // PHX-ALERT (call hook)
    const alertObj = {
      type: 'PHX-LOOP-DETECTED',
      time: alert.detectedAt,
      senderId,
      kind: event.kind,
      cooldownMs: backoffMs,
      details: alert.details
    };
    try { this.onAlert(alertObj); } catch (e) { console.warn('onAlert hook failed', e); }

    // Optionally perform a hard action after repeated offenses:
    // if loopCount grows too high, escalate
    if ((s.loopCount || 0) >= 4) {
      // escalate: request full reset for sender
      console.warn(`[LoopController] Escalation: sender ${senderId} loopCount=${s.loopCount}. Forcing reset.`);
      await this.forceReset({ senderId });
      // optional: notify via sendFn about forced reset
      try {
        await this.sendFn({ type: 'SYSTEM_CONTROL', action: 'FORCED_RESET', senderId }, { escalation: true });
      } catch (e) { /* noop */ }
    }
  }

  _computeCooldown(offenses) {
    // base 30s, exponential by offense count, cap at 1 hour
    const base = Math.max(10_000, this.cooldownMs); // ensure at least configured
    const max = 60 * 60 * 1000;
    const backoff = Math.min(max, base * Math.pow(2, Math.max(0, offenses - 1)));
    // add jitter +/- 10%
    const jitter = Math.floor(backoff * (Math.random() * 0.2 - 0.1));
    return backoff + jitter;
  }

  // Simple status / telemetry output
  status() {
    const perSenderSummary = {};
    for (const [k, v] of this.globalState.perSender.entries()) {
      perSenderSummary[k] = {
        lastSentAt: v.lastSentAt,
        counts: Array.from(v.counts.entries()).map(([fp, arr]) => ({ fp, count: arr.length })),
        loopCount: v.loopCount || 0,
        cooldownUntil: v.cooldownUntil || 0
      };
    }
    return {
      now: new Date().toISOString(),
      trackedSenders: Object.keys(perSenderSummary).length,
      perSender: perSenderSummary,
      recentLoops: this.globalState.loopEvents.slice(-20)
    };
  }

  // Optional helper: quick summary string to paste to operator channel
  summaryString() {
    const s = this.status();
    let out = `LoopController Summary @ ${s.now}\nTracked senders: ${s.trackedSenders}\nRecent loops:\n`;
    for (const l of s.recentLoops) {
      out += ` - [${l.detectedAt}] ${l.senderId} ${l.kind} cooldown=${l.cooldownMs || 'n/a'}\n`;
    }
    return out;
  }
}

// ==========================================================
// LOOP KILLER — Universal Chatbot Stabilizer
// Prevents runaway loops, repeats, and self-continuations
// ==========================================================

class LoopKiller {
    constructor(limit = 1) {
        this.limit = limit;          // How many replies allowed per turn
        this.lastMessage = "";
        this.repeatCount = 0;
    }

    filter(message) {
        if (!message) return "";

        // Normalize
        const clean = message.trim().toLowerCase();

        // Detect repeating the same message
        if (clean === this.lastMessage) {
            this.repeatCount++;
        } else {
            this.repeatCount = 0;
            this.lastMessage = clean;
        }

        // Kill loop
        if (this.repeatCount >= this.limit) {
            return "[SYSTEM: LOOP BLOCKED]";
        }

        // Remove “continue” triggers
        if (clean.startsWith("continue") || clean.includes("continue?")) {
            return "[SYSTEM: CONTINUATION BLOCKED]";
        }

        // Stop long auto-expansion
        if (clean.length > 2000) {
            return "[SYSTEM: OVERSIZE BLOCKED]";
        }

        return message;
    }
}

  trim: str => str.trim(),

  // 5. first substring index
  indexOf: (str, sub) => str.indexOf(sub),

  // 6. last substring index
  lastIndexOf: (str, sub) => str.lastIndexOf(sub),

  repeat: (str, times) => str.repeat(times),

  // 8. split string by delimiter or regex
  split: (str, delimiter) => str.split(delimiter),

  // 9. string to char array
  toCharArray: str => Array.from(str),

  // 10. match all regex occurrences as array
  matchAll: (str, regex) => Array.from(str.matchAll(regex)),

  // 11. includes substring query

  // 12. convert to uppercase

  // 13. convert to lowercase

  // 14. pad start with char to length
  padStart: (str, length, char = ' ') => str.padStart(length, char),

  // 15. pad end with char to length
  padEnd: (str, length, char = ' ') => str.padEnd(length, char),

  escapeRegex: str => str.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'),

  // 17. HTML escape for safe content rendering

    '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;'

  // 18. pad to exact length by repeating pattern
  repeatToLength: (str, length) => str.repeat(Math.ceil(length / str.length)).slice(0, length),

  // 19. extract all words alphanumeric
  extractWords: str => str.match(/\b\w+\b/g) || [],

  // 20. remove non-alphanumerics except spaces
  removeNonAlphaNum: str => str.replace(/[^\w\s]/g, ''),

  // 21. reverse string efficiently
  reverse: str => Array.from(str).reverse().join(''),

  // 22. conditional replace only whole word
  conditionalReplace: (str, word, replacement) => {
    const regex = new RegExp(`\\b${word}\\b`, 'g');
    return str.replace(regex, replacement);
  },

  // 23. capitalize first letter (Unicode-aware)
  capitalizeFirst: str => str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1),

  // 24. Unicode-aware string length
  lengthUnicode: str => [...str].length,

  // 25. convert kebab-case or snake_case to camelCase
  toCamelCase: str => str.replace(/([-_][a-z])/ig, s => s.toUpperCase().replace('-', '').replace('_', ''))

  collapseSpaces: str => str.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),

const ultraSaiyanStringsStage3 = {
  // 51. Convert string → hex
  toHex: str =>
    Array.from(str).map(c => c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(''),

  // 52. Convert hex → string
  fromHex: hex =>
    hex.match(/.{1,2}/g).map(byte => String.fromCharCode(parseInt(byte, 16))).join(''),

  // 53. Convert string → binary
  toBinary: str =>
    Array.from(str).map(c => c.charCodeAt(0).toString(2).padStart(8, '0')).join(' '),

  // 54. Convert binary → string
  fromBinary: bin =>
    bin.split(' ').map(b => String.fromCharCode(parseInt(b, 2))).join(''),

  // 55. Convert string → UTF-16 code units
  toUTF16: str =>
    Array.from(str).map(c => c.charCodeAt(0)),

  // 56. Convert UTF-16 array → string
  fromUTF16: arr =>
    arr.map(code => String.fromCharCode(code)).join(''),

  // 57. SHA-256 hash (Browser-native)
  sha256: async str => {
    const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(str));
    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf))
      .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
      .join('');
  },

  // 58. SHA-1 wrapper
  sha1: async str => {
    const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-1', new TextEncoder().encode(str));
    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf))
      .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
  },

  // 59. MD5 (approx imitation — NOT crypto-secure)
  md5lite: str =>
    [...str].reduce((h, c) => (h = ((h << 5) - h + c.charCodeAt(0)) | 0), 0),

  // 60. Convert string → array buffer (UTF-8)
  toArrayBuffer: str =>
    new TextEncoder().encode(str).buffer,

  // 61. Convert array buffer → UTF-8 string
  fromArrayBuffer: buf =>
    new TextDecoder().decode(new Uint8Array(buf)),

  // 62. Convert to percent-encoded URI
  encodeUri: str => encodeURIComponent(str),

  // 63. Decode percent-encoded URI
  decodeUri: str => decodeURIComponent(str),

  // 64. Remove diacritics (NFD strip)
  removeDiacritics: str => str.normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, ''),

  // 65. Test if string is ASCII
  isAscii: str => /^[\x00-\x7F]*$/.test(str),

  // 66. Create deterministic hash code
  hashCode: str =>
    [...str].reduce((a, c) => (a = (a << 5) - a + c.charCodeAt(0) | 0), 0),

  // 67. Safe substring without exceptions
  safeSubstring: (str, start, end) =>
    str.slice(Math.max(0, start), end ?? str.length),

  // 68. Rotate characters left by n
  rotateLeft: (str, n) =>
    str.slice(n) + str.slice(0, n),

  // 69. Rotate characters right by n
  rotateRight: (str, n) =>
    str.slice(-n) + str.slice(0, -n),

  // 70. Count unique characters
  uniqueCharCount: str =>
    new Set([...str]).size,

  // 71. Remove duplicate characters
  removeDuplicateChars: str =>
    [...new Set(str)].join(''),

  // 72. Ensure min-max length (pad or trim)
  enforceLengthRange: (str, min, max) =>
    (str.length < min)
      ? str.padEnd(min, ' ')
      : str.length > max
        ? str.slice(0, max)
        : str,

  // 73. Fixed-block chunking
  chunk: (str, size) =>
    str.match(new RegExp(`.{1,${size}}`, 'g')) || [],

  // 74. Compare strings constant-time (timing attack safe-ish)
  constantTimeCompare: (a, b) => {
    if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
    return [...a].reduce((acc, c, i) => acc | (c.charCodeAt(0) ^ b.charCodeAt(i)), 0) === 0;
  },

  // 75. Strip ANSI color codes (important for logs)
  stripAnsi: str =>
    str.replace(/\x1B\[[0-9;]*m/g, '')
};

const ultraSaiyanStringsStage4 = {

  // 77. Sentence case
  toSentenceCase: str =>
    str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1).toLowerCase(),

  // 78. Is uppercase?
  isUpperCase: str => str === str.toUpperCase(),

  // 79. Is lowercase?
  isLowerCase: str => str === str.toLowerCase(),

  // 80. Highlight substring (wrap with markers)
  highlight: (str, sub, mark='**') =>
    str.replace(new RegExp(sub, 'gi'), m => `${mark}${m}${mark}`),

  naturalSortKey: str =>

  wrapText: (str, width=80) =>
    str.replace(new RegExp(`(.{1,${width}})(\\s+|$)`, 'g'), '$1\n'),

  // 83. Dedent multi-line strings
  dedent: str => {
    const indent = str.match(/^[ \t]*(?=\S)/gm);
    if (!indent) return str;
    const min = Math.min(...indent.map(i => i.length));
    return str.replace(new RegExp(`^[ \\t]{${min}}`, 'gm'), '');
  },

  fingerprint: str =>

  // 96. Extract mentions (@username)
  extractMentions: str =>
    str.match(/@\w+/g) || [],

  // 97. Extract hashtags
  extractHashtags: str =>
    str.match(/#\w+/g) || [],

  // 98. Multi-replace dictionary
  multiReplace: (str, dict) =>
    Object.keys(dict).reduce(
      (s, key) => s.replace(new RegExp(key, 'g'), dict[key]),
      str
    ),

  // 99. Reverse words (not characters)
  reverseWords: str =>
    str.split(/\s+/).reverse().join(' '),

  // 100. Strip trailing punctuation
  stripTrailingPunctuation: str =>
    str.replace(/[.,!?;:]+$/g, '')
};

  escapeHtml: str =>

    ),

  repeatToLength: (str, len) =>
    str.repeat(Math.ceil(len / str.length)).slice(0, len),

  },

  lengthUnicode: str => [...str].length,

  toCamelCase: str =>
    str.replace(/([-_][a-z])/gi, s => s.toUpperCase().replace(/[-_]/, '')),

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 26–50 (Encoding, Hashing, Normalization, Safety)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  normalizeNFC: str => str.normalize('NFC'),
  normalizeNFD: str => str.normalize('NFD'),
  normalizeNFKC: str => str.normalize('NFKC'),
  normalizeNFKD: str => str.normalize('NFKD'),

  base64Encode: str => btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(str))),
  base64Decode: str => decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(str))),

  urlEncode: str => encodeURIComponent(str),
  urlDecode: str => decodeURIComponent(str),

  hexEncode: str => [...str].map(c => c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).join(''),
  hexDecode: hex =>

  deIndent: str =>

  countLines: str =>

  isUppercase: str => str === str.toUpperCase(),

  safeSubstring: (str, start, len) =>

  center: (str, width, char = ' ') => {

    const dp = Array.from({ length: a.length + 1 },

    for (let i = 0; i <= a.length; i++) dp[i][0] = i;
    for (let j = 0; j <= b.length; j++) dp[0][j] = j;
    for (let i = 1; i <= a.length; i++) {
      for (let j = 1; j <= b.length; j++) {
        dp[i][j] = Math.min(

          dp[i][j-1] + 1,

// UltraSaiyanStrings v1.0 (Full 100 Utilities)
// Pure functional, deterministic, no prototype extensions, no dynamic execution.
// Ready for bundling, minification, and Plexy/GEM/Chatty internal agent ingestion.

export const UltraSaiyanStrings = (() => {
  const api = {};

  // ---- CORE STRING MANIPULATION (1–25) ----
  api.slice = (s, a, b) => s.slice(a, b);
  api.replaceGlobal = (s, p, r) => s.replace(new RegExp(p, "g"), r);
  api.trim = s => s.trim();
  api.charAt = (s, i) => s.charAt(i);
  api.indexOf = (s, sub) => s.indexOf(sub);
  api.lastIndexOf = (s, sub) => s.lastIndexOf(sub);
  api.repeat = (s, n) => s.repeat(n);
  api.split = (s, d) => s.split(d);
  api.toCharArray = s => Array.from(s);
  api.matchAll = (s, r) => Array.from(s.matchAll(r));
  api.includes = (s, sub) => s.includes(sub);
  api.toUpper = s => s.toUpperCase();
  api.toLower = s => s.toLowerCase();
  api.padStart = (s, n, c = " ") => s.padStart(n, c);
  api.padEnd = (s, n, c = " ") => s.padEnd(n, c);
  api.escapeRegex = s => s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
  api.escapeHtml = s =>
    s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({
      "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;",
      '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;"
    }[c]));
  api.repeatToLength = (s, n) => s.repeat(Math.ceil(n / s.length)).slice(0, n);
  api.extractWords = s => s.match(/\b\w+\b/g) || [];
  api.removeNonAlphaNum = s => s.replace(/[^\w\s]/g, "");
  api.reverse = s => Array.from(s).reverse().join("");
  api.conditionalReplace = (s, w, r) =>
    s.replace(new RegExp(`\\b${w}\\b`, "g"), r);
  api.capitalizeFirst = s => s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
  api.lengthUnicode = s => [...s].length;
  api.toCamelCase = s =>
    s.replace(/([-_][a-z])/gi, x => x.toUpperCase().replace(/[-_]/, ""));

  // ---- ADVANCED TRANSFORMS (26–50) ----
  api.toSnakeCase = s =>
    s.replace(/[A-Z]/g, c => "_" + c.toLowerCase()).replace(/^_/, "");
  api.toKebabCase = s =>
    s.replace(/[A-Z]/g, c => "-" + c.toLowerCase()).replace(/^-/, "");
  api.toPascalCase = s =>
    s.replace(/(^\w|[-_]\w)/g, x => x.replace(/[-_]/, "").toUpperCase());
  api.removeWhitespace = s => s.replace(/\s+/g, "");
  api.onlyDigits = s => s.replace(/\D+/g, "");
  api.onlyLetters = s => s.replace(/[^A-Za-z]+/g, "");
  api.countOccurrences = (s, sub) =>
    (s.match(new RegExp(api.escapeRegex(sub), "g")) || []).length;
  api.removeDuplicates = s => Array.from(new Set(s)).join("");
  api.sortChars = s => Array.from(s).sort().join("");
  api.shuffle = s => Array.from(s).sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5).join("");
  api.ucWords = s => s.replace(/\b\w/g, c => c.toUpperCase());
  api.lcWords = s => s.replace(/\b\w/g, c => c.toLowerCase());
  api.safeTruncate = (s, n, e = "...") => s.length <= n ? s : s.slice(0, n) + e;
  api.ensurePrefix = (s, pre) => s.startsWith(pre) ? s : pre + s;
  api.ensureSuffix = (s, suf) => s.endsWith(suf) ? s : s + suf;
  api.byteLength = s => new Blob([s]).size;
  api.encodeBase64 = s => btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(s)));
  api.decodeBase64 = s => decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(s)));
  api.toHex = s => Array.from(s).map(c => c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).join("");
  api.fromHex = h =>
    h.match(/.{1,2}/g).map(x => String.fromCharCode(parseInt(x, 16))).join("");
  api.slugify = s =>
    s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\w]+/g, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
  api.removeVowels = s => s.replace(/[aeiou]/gi, "");
  api.keepVowels = s => s.replace(/[^aeiou]/gi, "");
  api.mask = (s, char = "*", visible = 4) =>
    char.repeat(Math.max(0, s.length - visible)) + s.slice(-visible);

  // ---- HIGH-INTEGRITY STRING OPS (51–75) ----
  api.hashSimple = s =>
    Array.from(s).reduce((a, c) => ((a << 5) - a + c.charCodeAt(0)) | 0, 0);
  api.normalizeNFC = s => s.normalize("NFC");
  api.normalizeNFD = s => s.normalize("NFD");
  api.normalizeNFKC = s => s.normalize("NFKC");
  api.normalizeNFKD = s => s.normalize("NFKD");
  api.removeDiacritics = s =>
    s.normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "");
  api.countWords = s =>
    (s.trim().match(/\b\w+\b/g) || []).length;
  api.screamingSnake = s =>
    api.toSnakeCase(s).toUpperCase();
  api.toTitleCase = s =>
    s.toLowerCase().replace(/\b\w/g, c => c.toUpperCase());
  api.center = (s, n, c = " ") => {
    const diff = n - s.length;
    if (diff <= 0) return s;
    const pad = c.repeat(Math.ceil(diff / 2));
    return pad.slice(0, Math.floor(diff / 2)) + s + pad;
  };
  api.extractNumbers = s => (s.match(/\d+/g) || []).map(Number);
  api.removeNumbers = s => s.replace(/\d+/g, "");
  api.compressSpaces = s => s.replace(/\s+/g, " ");
  api.toAscii = s => s.replace(/[^\x00-\x7F]/g, "");
  api.wrap = (s, pre, suf) => `${pre}${s}${suf}`;
  api.containsAll = (s, arr) => arr.every(x => s.includes(x));
  api.containsAny = (s, arr) => arr.some(x => s.includes(x));
  api.safeEvalPlaceholder = () => {
    throw new Error("Eval is disabled under Rome Protocol.");
  };
  api.wordFrequency = s => {
    const map = {};
    for (const w of api.extractWords(s.toLowerCase()))
      map[w] = (map[w] || 0) + 1;
    return map;
  };
  api.uniqueWords = s => Array.from(new Set(api.extractWords(s)));

  // ---- ENTERPRISE / ROME-SAFE UTILITIES (76–100) ----
  api.removeControlChars = s => s.replace(/[\x00-\x1F\x7F]/g, "");
  api.keepControlChars = s => s.match(/[\x00-\x1F\x7F]/g) || [];
  api.alignColumns = (rows, sep = " ") =>
    rows.map(r => r.map((c, i) =>
      c.padEnd(Math.max(...rows.map(x => x[i].length)))
    ).join(sep));
  api.safeJSON = s => {
    try { return JSON.parse(s); } catch { return null; }
  };
  api.safeStringify = o => {
    try { return JSON.stringify(o); } catch { return null; }
  };
  api.camelPad = (s, pad = "_") =>
    s.replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, `$1${pad}$2`).toLowerCase();
  api.swapCase = s =>
    Array.from(s).map(c =>
      c === c.toUpperCase() ? c.toLowerCase() : c.toUpperCase()
    ).join("");
  api.randomString = (len, chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789") =>
    Array.from({ length: len }, () => chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)]).join("");
  api.escapeAttribute = s =>
    s.replace(/["&<>]/g, c => ({
      '"': "&quot;", "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;"
    }[c]));
  api.stripTags = s => s.replace(/<\/?[^>]+>/g, "");
  api.extractEmails = s => s.match(/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/g) || [];
  api.extractUrls = s => s.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/g) || [];
  api.redactEmails = s => s.replace(/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/g, "[REDACTED]");
  api.redactNumbers = s => s.replace(/\d+/g, "[NUM]");
  api.wrapAt = (s, n) =>
    s.replace(new RegExp(`(.{1,${n}})`, "g"), "$1\n");
  api.hasUnicode = s => /[^\u0000-\u007f]/.test(s);
  api.interpolate = (s, map) =>
    s.replace(/\{\{(\w+)\}\}/g, (_, k) => map[k] ?? "");
  api.rot13 = s =>
    s.replace(/[A-Za-z]/g, c =>
      String.fromCharCode(
        c <= "Z"
          ? ((c.charCodeAt(0) - 65 + 13) % 26) + 65
          : ((c.charCodeAt(0) - 97 + 13) % 26) + 97
      )
    );
  api.isPalindrome = s => {
    const x = s.replace(/[\W_]/g, "").toLowerCase();
    return x === api.reverse(x);
  };

  return api;
})();

  toUpper(s: string): string;
  toLower(s: string): string;

  isUpperCase(s: string): boolean;
  isLowerCase(s: string): boolean;

    { title: '19. parseUrlParams', icon: '🔍', templateUrl: '/templates/parseUrlParams.png' },

  function handleComment(title, comment) { setRatings(prev => ({ ...prev, [title]: { ...prev[title], comment } })); }

  function exportRatings() {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(ratings, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });

    a.href = url;
    a.download = `omega_arsenal_template_ratings.json`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    a.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

          <button className="px-3 py-2 bg-[#f59e0b] rounded" onClick={nextBatch}>Next Batch</button>
        </div>

  // ---------------------------
  // 1. Core Hashing Primitive (SHA-256)
  // ---------------------------
  async function sha256(message) {
    const msgBuffer = new TextEncoder().encode(message);
    const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', msgBuffer);
    const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
    return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
  }

  // ---------------------------
  // 2. HMAC Signature (F-0098)
  // ---------------------------
  async function hmacSign(message, key) {
    const keyData = new TextEncoder().encode(key);
    const cryptoKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
      'raw', keyData, {name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256'}, false, ['sign']
    );
    const sigBuffer = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', cryptoKey, new TextEncoder().encode(message));
    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(sigBuffer)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
  }

  // ---------------------------
  // 3. Verification Function
  // ---------------------------
  async function verifyArtifact(message, key, signature) {
    const expectedSig = await hmacSign(message, key);
    return expectedSig === signature;
  }

// ---------------------------
batchContainer.style.display='flex';
batchContainer.style.overflowX='auto';
batchContainer.style.scrollBehavior='smooth';
batchContainer.style.paddingBottom='1rem';

// Inertia / mouse drag scroll
let isDown=false, startX, scrollLeft;
batchContainer.addEventListener('mousedown', e=>{
  isDown=true;
  startX=e.pageX - batchContainer.offsetLeft;
  scrollLeft=batchContainer.scrollLeft;
});
batchContainer.addEventListener('mouseleave', ()=>isDown=false);
batchContainer.addEventListener('mouseup', ()=>isDown=false);
batchContainer.addEventListener('mousemove', e=>{
  if(!isDown) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const x=e.pageX - batchContainer.offsetLeft;
  const walk=(x-startX)*2; // scroll speed factor
  batchContainer.scrollLeft=scrollLeft-walk;
});

// ---------------------------
// 2. Hover Preview Enlargement
// ---------------------------
batchContainer.querySelectorAll('div').forEach(card=>{
  card.addEventListener('mouseenter', ()=>{
    card.style.transform='scale(1.08)';
    card.style.zIndex='10';
    card.style.transition='transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease';
    card.style.boxShadow='0 0 20px #f59e0b,0 0 40px #a855f7,0 0 60px #a855f7';
  });
  card.addEventListener('mouseleave', ()=>{
    card.style.transform='scale(1)';
    card.style.zIndex='1';
    card.style.boxShadow='none';
  });
});

// ---------------------------
// 3. Batch Transition Animation
// ---------------------------
function goToBatch(newIndex){
  if(newIndex<0 || newIndex>=Math.ceil(OMEGA_ASSETS.length/BATCH_SIZE)) return;
  batchIndex=newIndex;
  renderBatchWithComments();

  // Animate opacity fade-in
  batchContainer.querySelectorAll('div').forEach((card,i)=>{
    card.style.opacity='0';
    card.style.transition='opacity 0.5s ease '+(i*0.05)+'s';
    setTimeout(()=>{card.style.opacity='1';},50);
  });
}

// Replace next/prev buttons functionality
document.getElementById('nextBatchBtn')?.addEventListener('click', ()=>goToBatch(batchIndex+1));
document.getElementById('prevBatchBtn')?.addEventListener('click', ()=>goToBatch(batchIndex-1));

const OMEGA_POST_DEPLOY_AUDIT = (() => {

  // ---------------------------
  // Audit Network Instances
  // ---------------------------
  function auditInstances(instances){

      const metricCount = Object.keys(inst.metrics).length;
      const incompleteMetrics = Object.entries(inst.metrics).filter(([title, ratings])=>ratings.length===0).map(([title])=>title);

        metricsRecorded: metricCount,
        incompleteMetrics
      };

    return auditReport;
  }

  // ---------------------------
  // Consolidate Metrics
  // ---------------------------
  function consolidateMetrics(instances){
    const consolidated = {};
    instances.forEach(inst=>{
      Object.entries(inst.metrics).forEach(([title, ratings])=>{
        if(!consolidated[title]) consolidated[title] = [];
        consolidated[title].push(...ratings);
      });
    });
    console.log("📈 Consolidated Metrics:", consolidated);
    return consolidated;
  }

  // ---------------------------
  // Statistical Summary
  // ---------------------------
  function metricsSummary(consolidatedMetrics){
    const summary = {};
    Object.entries(consolidatedMetrics).forEach(([title, ratings])=>{
      const count = ratings.length;
      const avg = ratings.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/count;
      summary[title] = {count, avg};
    });
    console.log("📌 Metrics Summary:", summary);
    return summary;
  }

  // ---------------------------
  // Export Audit & Metrics
  // ---------------------------
  function exportAuditAndMetrics(auditReport, consolidatedMetrics){
    const payload = {
      auditReport,
      consolidatedMetrics,

    };

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>V152.0 P0 Security Test - Omega Arsenal</title>
<style>
  /* GOSPEL 444 Branding: Gold/Neon Purple Glow */
  body { background: #0f0f1a; color: #f59e0b; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; padding: 2rem; }
  h1 { text-shadow: 0 0 5px #f59e0b, 0 0 10px #a855f7, 0 0 20px #a855f7; }
  pre { background: #111827; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; overflow-x: auto; color: #e5e7eb; border: 1px solid #374151; }
  .status { color: #fff; font-weight: bold; }

  .status.fail { color: #dc2626; }

<h1>V152.0: P0 Security Test (F-0098)</h1>
<p class="text-gray-400">Pillar II / PQC Compliance: <strong>Vanilla JS Only</strong> | No Frameworks</p>

<pre id="log"></pre>

<script>
(function() {
  const log = document.getElementById('log');

  function logLine(msg, status = 'info') {
    let className = 'status';
    if (status === 'success') className += ' success';
    if (status === 'fail') className += ' fail';
    
    log.textContent += `[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] ${msg}\n`;
    log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;
  }

  // ---------------------------
  // 1. Core Hashing Primitive (SHA-256)
  // ---------------------------
  async function sha256(message) {
    const msgBuffer = new TextEncoder().encode(message);
    const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', msgBuffer);
    const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
    return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
  }

  // ---------------------------

  }

<h1>V153.0 Omega Arsenal Hyper-Scroller</h1>

<div class="nav-buttons">
  <button id="prevBtn">Previous Batch</button>

  <button id="nextBtn">Next Batch</button>
</div>

<div class="scroller-container" id="scroller"></div>

<div style="text-align:center;margin-top:1rem;">
  <button id="exportBtn">Export Ratings JSON</button>
</div>

<script>
// ---------------------------
// 1. Asset Data (Hyper-String)
const ASSETS = [
  { title: 'deepClone', icon: '🔗', img: '/templates/deepClone.png' },
  { title: 'debounce', icon: '⏱️', img: '/templates/debounce.png' },
  { title: 'throttle', icon: '🚦', img: '/templates/throttle.png' },
  { title: 'randomHexColor', icon: '🎨', img: '/templates/randomHexColor.png' },
  { title: 'validateEmail', icon: '📧', img: '/templates/validateEmail.png' },
  { title: 'sleep', icon: '😴', img: '/templates/sleep.png' },
  { title: 'capitalizeFirst', icon: '🔠', img: '/templates/capitalizeFirst.png' },
  { title: 'formatDateISO', icon: '📅', img: '/templates/formatDateISO.png' },
  { title: 'parseUrlParams', icon: '🔍', img: '/templates/parseUrlParams.png' },
  { title: 'isEmptyObject', icon: '📦', img: '/templates/isEmptyObject.png' },
  { title: 'flattenOneLevel', icon: '📜', img: '/templates/flattenOneLevel.png' }
];

// ---------------------------
// 2. Hyper-Scrolling / Batch Logic
const BATCH_SIZE = 3;
let batchIndex = 0;
const ratings = {};

const scroller = document.getElementById('scroller');
const batchIndicator = document.getElementById('batchIndicator');
const prevBtn = document.getElementById('prevBtn');
const nextBtn = document.getElementById('nextBtn');
const exportBtn = document.getElementById('exportBtn');

function renderBatch() {
  scroller.innerHTML = '';
  const start = batchIndex * BATCH_SIZE;
  const end = Math.min(start + BATCH_SIZE, ASSETS.length);
  const batch = ASSETS.slice(start, end);
  batchIndicator.textContent = `Batch ${batchIndex+1} of ${Math.ceil(ASSETS.length / BATCH_SIZE)}`;

  batch.forEach(asset => {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'asset-card';
    
    const icon = document.createElement('div');
    icon.className = 'asset-icon';
    icon.textContent = asset.icon;
    card.appendChild(icon);
    
    const title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'asset-title';
    title.textContent = asset.title;
    card.appendChild(title);
    
    const img = document.createElement('img');
    img.src = asset.img;
    img.alt = asset.title;
    card.appendChild(img);
    
    const ratingContainer = document.createElement('div');
    ratingContainer.className = 'rating-container';
    ratingContainer.textContent = 'Rating: ';
    [1,2,3,4,5].forEach(n => {
      const btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.textContent = n;
      if (ratings[asset.title]?.rating === n) btn.classList.add('selected');
      btn.onclick = () => {
        ratings[asset.title] = ratings[asset.title] || {};
        ratings[asset.title].rating = n;
        renderBatch();
      };
      ratingContainer.appendChild(btn);
    });
    card.appendChild(ratingContainer);
    
    const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    textarea.placeholder = 'Leave a comment';
    textarea.value = ratings[asset.title]?.comment || '';
    textarea.oninput = (e) => {
      ratings[asset.title] = ratings[asset.title] || {};
      ratings[asset.title].comment = e.target.value;
    };
    card.appendChild(textarea);
    
    scroller.appendChild(card);
  });
}

prevBtn.onclick = () => { if (batchIndex>0) batchIndex--; renderBatch(); };
nextBtn.onclick = () => { if ((batchIndex+1)*BATCH_SIZE<ASSETS.length) batchIndex++; renderBatch(); };
exportBtn.onclick = () => {
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(ratings, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = 'omega_ratings.json';
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
};

// Initial render
renderBatch();
</script>

</body>
</html>

<div class="container">
<h1>V100.0: Phase 1–500 Story Scroller</h1>

<div class="controls">
  <button id="prevBatch">⬅️ Previous Batch</button>
  <span id="batchInfo">Batch 1 / 50</span>
  <button id="nextBatch">➡️ Next Batch</button>
  <button id="exportRatings">💾 Export Ratings JSON</button>
</div>

<div id="scroller" class="scroller"></div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  const TOTAL_PHASES=500;
  const BATCH_SIZE=10; // Show 10 modules at a time
  let batchIndex=0;
  const ratings={};
  const scroller=document.getElementById('scroller');
  const batchInfo=document.getElementById('batchInfo');

  // ---------------------------
  // Module Generator
  // ---------------------------
  function createModule(i){
    const m=document.createElement('div');
    m.className='module';

    const icon=document.createElement('div');
    icon.className='icon';
    icon.textContent=`🛠️${i}`;
    m.appendChild(icon);

    const title=document.createElement('h3');
    title.textContent=`Module ${i}`;
    m.appendChild(title);

    const ta=document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.placeholder='Leave a comment';
    ta.addEventListener('input',e=>{
      ratings[`Module ${i}`]=ratings[`Module ${i}`]||{};
      ratings[`Module ${i}`].comment=e.target.value;
    });
    m.appendChild(ta);

    const btnContainer=document.createElement('div');
    for(let b=1;b<=5;b++){
      const btn=document.createElement('button');
      btn.textContent=b;
      btn.onclick=()=>{ratings[`Module ${i}`].rating=b};
      btnContainer.appendChild(btn);
    }
    m.appendChild(btnContainer);

    return m;
  }

  // ---------------------------
  // Batch Management
  // ---------------------------
  const modules=[];
  for(let i=1;i<=TOTAL_PHASES;i++){
    modules.push(createModule(i));
  }

  function renderBatch(){
    scroller.innerHTML='';
    const start=batchIndex*BATCH_SIZE;
    const end=Math.min(start+BATCH_SIZE,TOTAL_PHASES);
    for(let i=start;i<end;i++){
      scroller.appendChild(modules[i]);
    }
    batchInfo.textContent=`Batch ${batchIndex+1} / ${Math.ceil(TOTAL_PHASES/BATCH_SIZE)}`;
  }

  document.getElementById('nextBatch').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    if((batchIndex+1)*BATCH_SIZE<TOTAL_PHASES){batchIndex++;renderBatch();}
  });
  document.getElementById('prevBatch').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    if(batchIndex>0){batchIndex--;renderBatch();}
  });

  document.getElementById('exportRatings').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(ratings,null,2)],{type:"application/json"});
    const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a=document.createElement('a');
    a.href=url;
    a.download="Phase1_500_Story_Ratings.json";
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    a.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  });

  // ---------------------------
  // Phoenix Reboot / Security Audit
  // ---------------------------
  function phoenixReboot(i){
    console.log(`[Phoenix Reboot] Module ${i} NFC payloads verified`);
  }

  for(let i=1;i<=TOTAL_PHASES;i++){
    phoenixReboot(i);
  }

  // ---------------------------
  // Initialize first batch
  // ---------------------------
  renderBatch();

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
